rows.note: Use 古老 as the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is very old.

example.jyutping: nei1 zo6 kiu4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gu2 lou5

rows.note: Use 古代嘅 when something belongs to a distant historical era, especially in contrast with modern things.

example.english: Ancient people didn’t have mobile phones.
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 ge3 jan4 mou5 sau2 gei1
